nc.description: A blank white can sits in a grey, geometric stand with an overhanging arm holding a circular piece just above the can's top.
A 3D rendering shows a gray mechanical linkage featuring a shaft, a universal joint, and a coil spring with stylized lines indicating rotation.
Three angled, corrugated cylindrical mounts with flat bases are arranged together to support an interlocking top structure against a white background.
A multi-pronged grey structure grips a faceted sphere next to a radiating arrangement of white, wedge-shaped forms.
Multiple light grey, three-dimensional arrows and geometric shapes are arranged to point inwards, converging on a central, faceted white object against a white background.

vc.description: A mechanical device with handles and a lever is shown with a segmented white cylinder partially inserted into its center and a detached threaded cap hovering directly above it.
A 3D rendering depicts a grey mechanical assembly consisting of a spring-loaded linkage connected to a geared hub and a rotating threaded shaft.
A light gray mechanical assembly featuring four suction-cup bases, four coiled springs, central gears, and two intertwined handles rests on a plain white surface.
A gray 3D rendering depicts a mechanical assembly featuring three cylindrical rods connecting to a central housing with a knurled wheel, opposite three articulated robotic fingers.
A light grey handgun frame is centrally displayed on a white surface, surrounded by a circular arrangement of various metal parts, ribbed plates, and piles of small pellets.
